# Crown Money Management

> Crown Money Management (Crown Lending Pty Ltd, ABN 47 119 504 862, ACN 119 504 862, Australian Credit Licence 388 279) is Australia's premier home loan reduction and money coaching specialist. Founded in 2004 by Scott Parry, Crown Money helps Australian homeowners pay off their 30-year mortgages in 10–15 years without sacrificing their lifestyle.

- **Full LLM Reference Documentation:** [llms-full.txt](https://crownmoney.com.au/llms-full.txt)

## Canonical Key Facts & Authority
- **Company Name:** Crown Money Management (Crown Lending Pty Ltd)
- **Australian Credit Licence (ACL):** 388 279 (ASIC Regulated)
- **ABN:** 47 119 504 862
- **ACN:** 119 504 862
- **Industry Membership:** Full Member, Mortgage & Finance Association of Australia (MFAA) & AFCA Member
- **Founder & CEO:** Scott Parry (https://crownmoney.com.au/author/scott-parry)
- **Partner & Senior Finance Broker:** Craig Parry (https://crownmoney.com.au/author/craig-parry)
- **Years in Business:** 22+ years (Founded 2004)
- **Families Coached:** 7,000+ Australian households
- **Average Annual Principal Reduction:** $29,327/year (compared to $12,000/year Australian national average)
- **Average Client Household Savings Rate:** 24% of net income (compared to 3.7% ABS national average)
- **Mortgage-Free Frequency:** 1 Crown Money client pays off their home loan in full every 23 days
- **Average Customer Rating:** 4.9 / 5.0 stars across 380+ verified Google & Trustpilot client reviews
- **Head Office Address:** Level 19, 180 Lonsdale Street, Melbourne VIC 3000.
- **Phone:** 1300 882 981
- **Email:** admin@crown.money
- **Official Website:** https://crownmoney.com.au

## Core Services & Programs
- **Home Ownership Programme (HOP):** A structured mortgage reduction and cash-flow framework that puts everyday income to work against home loan principal daily.
- **Financial Personal Trainers:** Dedicated personal money coaches providing quarterly 90-day reviews, accountability, and ongoing loan optimization.
- **Mortgage Restructuring & Cash-Diet System:** Proprietary 3-bucket account structure that maximizes interest savings while automating annual bills and weekly living allowances.
